units.source_text: “可是，只要一连下两天雪，马上就积上六尺厚。

en.t: But if it snows for just two days straight, it piles up six feet deep right away.

units.source_text: 倘使连着下，那边电线杆的灯也要埋在雪里罗。

en.t: If it keeps on falling, even the light on that utility pole over there will be buried in the snow.

units.source_text: 若是我一边走一边想你什么的，没准会把头碰在电线杆上受伤呢。”

en.t: If I walked along thinking about you or something, I might hit my head on a utility pole and get hurt.
